cn.t: Critics praise this inventive, sympathetic adaptation of Abby Chava Stein's memoir as a powerful and specific trans story, with strong performances from Tommy Dorfman and Brandon Uranowitz expertly conveying the anguish of leaving an ultra-Orthodox community.
